name: Unidentified Threat Actors (Citrix NetScaler & Enterprise Infrastructure Exploitation)
description:
2026-08-26 | Active Exploitation of Citrix NetScaler and Enterprise IT Assets
Target: Enterprise perimeter infrastructure, NetScaler ADC/Gateway systems, and enterprise database servers across critical infrastructure and supply chain entities.
Vector: Exploitation of active KEV catalog vulnerabilities including Citrix NetScaler memory buffer restriction flaw (CVE-2026-8452), Microsoft SQL Server RCE (CVE-2019-1068), Ajax.NET Professional deserialization (CVE-2021-23758), and Linux kernel flaws (CVE-2022-0995, CVE-2015-3246, CVE-2015-5287).
Impact: Remote code execution, privilege escalation, unauthorized perimeter access, and total compromise of exposed network appliances.

name: Unidentified Threat Actors (JFrog Artifactory & ownCloud Exploitation)
description:
2026-08-27 | Active Exploitation of ownCloud and JFrog Artifactory Repositories
Target: Enterprise file sync/share instances, DevOps/software supply chain artifact repositories (JFrog Artifactory), and Linux hosting environments.
Vector: Exploitation of ownCloud improper authentication (CVE-2023-49105), JFrog Artifactory pathname traversal to restricted directories (CVE-2026-66384), and Linux kernel vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-53362).
Impact: Unauthorized authentication bypass, sensitive data and credential leakage, directory traversal, and potential software supply chain compromise.
